entities.name: Protocol configuration options
entities.description: This IE is included in messages when the network wishes to transmit protocol data such as configuration parameters, error codes, or messages/events to the UE.

entities.name: Extended protocol configuration options not supported
entities.description: Condition where the extended protocol configuration options is not supported by the UE or the network end-to-end for the PDN connection.

entities.name: Network transmits protocol data to UE
entities.description: The network transmits protocol data such as configuration parameters, error codes, or messages/events to the UE.

relations.description: The PCO IE is included when the extended protocol configuration options is not supported.
Inclusion of the PCO IE enables the network to transmit protocol data to the UE.
